label: Automated technical rehearsal — not a human pilot
scenario: Add multiple products, adjust quantity/remove an item, then checkout without a coupon

observations.detail: Two selected products should appear as separate cart rows.
The cart exposes quantity as read-only text; no +/− controls exist.
The item is removed immediately, without the FR-24 confirmation dialog.
Coupon input remained blank and no discount was applied.
The SUT displayed its success state.
The purchased item remains in the cart after checkout, contrary to FR-08.
